name: Surge Metrics
description: Medium and Large widgets for Surge iOS metrics with outbound mode / global policy control and K-formatted cumulative request count: traffic, memory, requests, DNS cache, uptime, interfaces.

localizedDescriptions.zh: Surge iOS Prometheus 指标小组件，并可在小组件上切换运行模式、在全局模式下切换节点或策略组：Medium 聚焦累计流量与核心状态，Large 展开网络接口流量。
localizedDescriptions.en: Surge iOS metrics widgets with outbound mode and global policy control. Medium focuses on cumulative traffic and runtime status; Large adds per-interface traffic.
